Transcript:Sugadinti Vitur.wikitext:
{{Transcript|npc}}

==Standard dialogue==
* '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' Welcome back, my child.
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|How are things in Morytania?}}
** '''Player:''' How are things in Morytania?
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' Very good, my child. My disciples are providing a steady supply of their blood for the vampyres. As promised, the tithing of humans has been completely outlawed.
** '''Player:''' And the vampyres are all happy with that?
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' Most are understanding of the fact that regardless of anything else, the days of tithing humans were running short. However, it is true that some found human blood to be more... appetising.
** '''Player:''' I assume that won't be a problem?
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' You need not fear, my child. Any that attempt to take blood from a human will be dealt with harshly.
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' That said, my understanding is that some humans did willingly provide their blood to the Drakans. It is of course possible that could be explored again in future, albeit with very different arrangements.
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' However, I very much understand that will likely be a... difficult proposal for most to swallow.
** '''Player:''' Yes, I can't see many being up for that sort of thing. Speaking of which, how are the humans of Morytania doing?
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' The fact that they are not being tithed is on its own a significant improvement to their quality of life. However, their homes are still ruins and these lands are still dangerous.
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' We are offering our help in building them new homes, but it will take many years, and most are still naturally distrusting of our kind.
** '''Player:''' I'm guessing a lot will be more interested in starting new lives across the Salve.
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' You are correct, my child. However, while we have established somewhat of an... understanding with your human kingdoms to the west, it is their preference that we try to limit how many humans relocate over there.
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' They are not equipped to deal with a large number of refugees, and it is also our hope that many humans will realise they still have a place here. We will need their help restoring these lands to glory.
** '''Player:''' That's not going to be an easy undertaking.
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' It will most certainly take many of your human lifetimes, but I have no doubt we will make it so.
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|I see you've opened a new portal to Vampyrium.}}
** '''Player:''' I see you've opened a new portal to Vampyrium.
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' Yes... While my disciples are currently providing blood for the vampyres here, I do not consider that a suitable long-term solution. Haemalchemy, I believe, will be the true answer.
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' With us having outlawed the practice of vampyrification, we have started using the labs to explore the creation of artificial blood instead. Curiously, we've already had some luck with daeyalt of all things.
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' It seems that the very substance that is the key to making vampyres can also potentially contribute to feeding them. While it makes sense in many ways, it was also rather... unexpected.
** '''Player:''' Interesting... And how does Vampyrium play into this?
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' Vampyrium is home to all manner of flora and fauna that cannot be found here. With the threat of Drakan dealt with, my disciples can freely travel to and from there, collecting samples to use in our experiments.
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' You are more than welcome to use the portal yourself, my child. Blood donations from Efaritay and my disciples keep it well powered, and it may be that you'll find Vampyrium to offer something of interest to you.
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|I'd best be off.}}
** '''Player:''' I'd best be off.
** '''Sugadinti Vitur:''' Until next time, my child.
** {{tact|end}}

Transcript:Supervisor Lalo.wikitext:
{{Transcript|npc}}

==Standard dialogue==
===The first time the player talks to Supervisor Lalo===
* '''Player:''' Hello there.
* '''Supervisor Lalo:''' I've not seen your face before. Given they let you come down here, I'm assuming you've been allowed to join the Alchemical Society?
* '''Player:''' That's right!
* '''Supervisor Lalo:''' Well in that case, just through there is the lab we use to produce potions for the kingdom. However, before you head in and get started, there's a couple of things to note.
* '''Supervisor Lalo:''' First, I can see you're not from around here, so I'll point out that Varlamorian Alchemy is a little different from the Druidic Herblore that you'll be familiar with.
* '''Player:''' How so?
* '''Supervisor Lalo:''' We discovered that the majority of herbs in the world can be broken down into three alchemical reagents: Mox, Aga and Lye.
* '''Supervisor Lalo:''' When mixed in the correct way, these three components produce drastically different results. As such, in the lab you will be using these components to create various potions.
* '''Player:''' What potions do I need to make?
* '''Supervisor Lalo:''' That depends. We get orders in from across the kingdom. You'll need to keep an eye out for what potions are currently desired and ensure you're making the right ones.
* {{tbox|}}
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|Let's do that run through.}}
** '''Player:''' Let's do that run through.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' Very well... Listen closely.
** {{qact|The scene cuts to each part of the laboratory as they are discussed}}
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' Start by breaking down herbs or unfinished potions over at the {{Colour|#6800bf|Refiner}}. This will give you your reagents: {{Colour|#6800bf|Mox}}, {{Colour|#6800bf|Aga}}, and {{Colour|#6800bf|Lye}} paste. The type you get will depend on the quality of what you put in.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' Insert the paste into the {{Colour|#6800bf|Hopper}} and it will become available to use in the {{Colour|#6800bf|Mixer}}.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' From here, you'll need to pull the {{Colour|#6800bf|Mixer Levers}} to create the right combination of reagents.
** '''Player:''' But how do I know what the combinations are?
** {{tcond|If the player has [[mixology lab notes]]:}}
*** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' I see you've already found our book of lab notes. That'll give you the formulas for our various products.
** {{tcond|If the player does not have mixology lab notes:}}
*** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' Have a look on the bookshelf for a book of lab notes. That'll give you the formulas for our various products.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' To know what needs making, you'll need to check the order list. There will always be three orders to choose from. You can work on just one or them, or multiple. It's up to you.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' Just be aware that demand shifts fast here. Every time you fulfil one or more orders, a new set will come through.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' Now, once you have set your desired combination of reagents, collect the unfinished mixture from the {{Colour|#6800bf|Mixing}} {{Colour|#6800bf|Vessel}}. This will then need to be processed on one of the three tables to finish it off.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' The {{Colour|#6800bf|Alembic}} will {{Colour|#6800bf|Crystalise}} the mixture.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' The {{Colour|#6800bf|Agitator}} will {{Colour|#6800bf|Homogenise}} the mixture.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' And finally, the {{Colour|#6800bf|Retort}} will {{Colour|#6800bf|Concentrate}} the mixture.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' After processing, place the finished mixture on the {{Colour|#6800bf|Conveyor Belt}} and move on to the next order.
** '''Player:''' What if I get an order wrong, or am unable to fulfil any of the orders?
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' We always have need for spares, so fulfilling an incorrect order will still grant you a small reward and will refresh the orders.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' One final thing to mention... We have some {{Colour|#6800bf|Digweed}} growing in the lab.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' These rare herbs will occasionally come into maturity for a short period of time. Harvest them while you can!
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' Mixing some into your product will increase its potency and grant you bonus rewards.
** '''Player:''' Bonus rewards?
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' That's right. As you produce potions, you'll find yourself collecting three types of {{Colour|#6800bf|Resin}}. The types obtained depend on what reagents are used, with the quantities being determined by the complexity of the
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' potion.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' Potions using {{Colour|#6800bf|Digweed}} will reward additional {{Colour|#6800bf|Resin}}, as will handing in multiple potions in one go.
** '''Player:''' Got it! So, refine herbs, deposit into the hopper, mix some products, process them, and then throw them on the conveyor. Seems easy enough!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|I'm sure I can work it out.}}
** '''Player:''' I'm sure I can work it out.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' Suit yourself. I'll be here if you change your mind.
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Supervisor Lalo after the first interaction===
* '''Supervisor Lalo:''' What is it?
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|Can you explain how to make potions?}}
** '''Player:''' Can you explain how to make potions?
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' Very well... Listen closely.
** {{tact|above}}

* {{topt|Can you tell me more about the Alchemical Society?}}
** '''Player:''' Can you tell me more about the Alchemical Society?
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' Can't imagine there's much to tell beyond what you already know. We exist to bring about advancements in Herblore, but in truth, a lot of what we produce doesn't directly contribute to that.
** '''Supervisor Lalo:''' Instead, many of the potions we make here are simply to sell. Doing so is what provides the funding we need to further our true goals.

===Initial dialogue===
* '''Player:''' Hello! Are you the leader of this expedition?

==Before talking to Captain Pudi with level 35 Fishing==
* '''Player:''' Hi, my name is [player name]. What's wi...
* '''Taiman:''' I not be in the mood t' talk, sorry. If ye need anythin', talk to Cap'ain Pudi over by the dock.

==After talking to Captain Pudi with level 35 Fishing==
* '''Taiman:''' I cannot believe that beast ruined me ship.
* {{topt|What happened to your ship?}}
** '''Player:''' What happened to your ship?
** '''Taiman:''' Was awful, me crew an' I were out on our fortnightly fishin' excursion. We set sail from Al Kharid t' the deep-sea fishin' spot we usually use.
** '''Taiman:''' Was nothin' but smooth sailin' all the way, we got t' the spot an' started fishin'.
** '''Player:''' Sounds like a normal day of fishing to me.
** '''Taiman:''' Aye, I s'pose it was. After a few days, the crew an' I sailed further t' the Karamjan coast t' catch some sharks. More plunder from sellin' sharks.
** '''Taiman:''' While sailin', I noticed there was more debris than usual. Koanee said there must have been a storm recently.
** '''Player:''' How did she know that?
** '''Taiman:''' Koanee is in charge of plottin' a course t' our destination an' watchin' the weather. I thought she was good at her job.
** '''Taiman:''' We got to our final fishin' spot an' Lauretta let down the net. Almost a whole day went by an' we still 'ad not caught any fish.
** '''Taiman:''' In fact, I could not see any fish in the waters at all. Such a strange sight.
** '''Player:''' Not even bass?
** '''Taiman:''' Nothin'. We decided t' pack it in for the day an' I told Koanee t' leave the nets down, hoping we would catch some fish overnight.
** '''Player:''' That sounds like a bad idea. What would have happened if your net got too full or your ship started drifting and the net got caught on some rocks?
** '''Taiman:''' 'Twas a risk we 'ad to take t' catch some fish.
** '''Taiman:''' The next day Koanee woke me up t' tell me a storm was on the horizon, so we lifted the anchor up an' adjusted our course.
** '''Taiman:''' Not sure what she was playing at with that decision, but out o' nowhere winds started t' change an' the storm was headin' in our direction, we couldn't outrun it.
** '''Taiman:''' 'Twas also too dangerous to anchor down, so we 'ad to weather it.
** '''Taiman:''' Thick fog rolled in, giant waves crashin' against the ship's hull. So much lightnin', it felt like Saradomin was angry with us.
** '''Taiman:''' The lightnin' struck our sails, settin' them ablaze despite the 'eavy rain!
** '''Taiman:''' The last thing I see is glowin' fish an' a monster in the distance with a twisted face. Next thing I know, I'm lying on the shore just south of Al Kharid with Pudi waving a kebab in me face!
** '''Player:''' That must have been awful. At least you and the crew survived.
** '''Taiman:''' Aye, we survived, but the same cannot be said for me poor ship! Koanee should 'o known better!
** '''Taiman:''' Once Pudi and the others helped us back on our feet, the Chancellor sent us 'ere t' setup shop and recruit others.
** '''Taiman:''' Not really my area of expertise, mind, but Pudi sorts most of it out!
** '''Taiman:''' Anythin' else I can help ye with?
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?}}
** '''Player:''' Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
** '''Taiman:''' Always carry an 'ammer. That beast has a habit of destroyin' ships. You can fix it up by using said 'ammer.
** '''Taiman:''' The Spirit Anglers' ships you fight the beast from are kitted out with everythin' ye need.
** '''Taiman:''' Can I help ye with anythin' else?
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|I found your ship's log.}}
** '''Player:''' I found your ship's log.
** '''Taiman:''' Ye be stealin' me booty are ye?
** '''Player:''' No, I jus...
** '''Taiman:''' I be yankin' ye chain, 'tis all good. I put that 'ere book on that shelf so I may spread me tale.
** '''Player:''' It was a good tale. Is it true?
** '''Taiman:''' Of course 'tis true! Ye can ask me all about it.
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|I have to go.}}
** '''Player:''' I have to go.
** '''Taiman:''' Be seein' ye.
** {{tact|end}}

Transcript:Tarik.wikitext:
{{Transcript|npc}}

==Initial dialogue==
* '''Tarik:''' Ouch!
* '''Player:''' Are you alright?
* '''Tarik:''' I'm fine, I'm fine. Just a scratch.
* '''Player:''' If you're sure. Who are you?
* '''Tarik:''' Me? I'm Tarik.
* '''Player:''' That hat you're wearing doesn't look like it comes from around here?
* '''Tarik:''' It was a present. My employer thought it would suit me. I'm not sure it does, though it does keep the sun off very well.
* '''Player:''' Who is this employer?
* '''Tarik:''' Simon Templeton. He's an archaeologist. I worked as an assistant for him, though I haven't seen him since the plague business started, so I work for myself now.
* '''Player:''' I see. So what have you been up to?
* '''Tarik:''' Simon suggested that there might be riches to be found in this pyramid.
* '''Tarik:''' All I've found so far are injuries though.
* {{tcond|If the player has never played the Pyramid Plunder minigame:}}
** '''Player:''' Interesting... What can you tell me about this pyramid?
** '''Tarik:''' Well, I'm not sure. It's called Jalsavrah apparently. It's a strange place.
** '''Player:''' How so?
** '''Tarik:''' First of all, there's something odd about the doors. There's four of them, but three of them lead to an empty tomb.
** '''Tarik:''' The other one is guarded by something, and whatever it is, it doesn't like visitors.
** '''Tarik:''' The thing is, the doors seem to change around sometimes. It's all quite confusing.
** '''Player:''' What's this thing guarding one of them.{{sic|punctuation}}
** '''Tarik:''' I think it might be a mummy. It's not very friendly, but it does allow you to enter some of the rooms in the tomb. They are dangerous though.
** '''Player:''' Well I'm not afraid of a little danger.
** '''Tarik:''' Are you sure? The place is full of poisonous snakes and scarabs along with some rather nasty mummies as well. You could die in there.
** '''Tarik:''' I managed to get into one room, but the next room was harder. My lockpicking skills weren't good enough. Maybe I should have taken a lockpick.
** '''Player:''' It all sounds like fun to me. So, is there anything valuable in there?
** '''Tarik:''' There are lots of artefacts that you should be able to sell to a legitimate trader...
** '''Player:''' Like your friend Simon Templeton?
** '''Tarik:''' Of course. He's as 'legitimate' as you can get.
** '''Player:''' Is there anything else of value in there?
** '''Tarik:''' I've heard a rumour that there is an ancient magic sceptre somewhere inside.
** '''Player:''' Ah, now you've piqued my interest. What do you know about this sceptre?
** '''Tarik:''' Not a lot. It's apparently made of gold and covered in jewels. It's supposed to have some magical powers as well.
** '''Player:''' Magical powers? This sounds good. What are they?
** '''Tarik:''' I'll let you know when I find it!
** '''Player:''' Not if I find it first!
** '''Tarik:''' Hey! if you find it, I deserve a share of the profits! You wouldn't have known it existed without my help.
** '''Player:''' I'll think about it...
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player has played the Pyramid Plunder minigame:}}
** '''Player:''' Yes, it's an odd place, isn't it?
** '''Tarik:''' You've been inside? Did you find anything?
** '''Player:''' Nothing of particular note...
** '''Tarik:''' Well if you do, I'd appreciate a share of any profits.
** '''Player:''' Right... I'll think about it...
** {{tact|end}}

Transcript:The Sage (Shattered Relics Le.wikitext:
{{Transcript|npc}}

==Standard dialogue==
* '''The Sage:''' Greetings, how may I be of service.
* {{topt|Who are you? What is your name?}}
** '''Player:''' Who are you? What is your name?
** '''The Sage:''' Who am I?
** '''The Sage:''' I am whatever is needed of me.
** '''The Sage:''' I am a form undefined by natural laws, manifested by someone we mustn't speak of.
** '''The Sage:''' I'm a clay doll, shaped by a sculptor. Never allowed to set, forever malleable. But maybe, not for long...
** '''The Sage:''' My true name is immaterial, But you may call me...
** '''The Sage:''' Let's see now, what would be most appropriate?
** '''The Sage:''' Ah, yes.
** '''The Sage:''' You may call me The Sage.
** '''Player:''' Uhhh, ok... Sage. Where did you bring us?
** '''The Sage:''' 'Where' is the right question my friend, but maybe not in the way you are accustomed to hearing.
** '''The Sage:''' Reality as you know it has many layers, all slightly different with their own rules.
** '''The Sage:''' Through the power granted to me, I brought us to this layer using the River-Between. The River of Souls.
** '''The Sage:''' We now stand on the stage of what is yet to be your most entertaining performance yet!
** '''Player:''' Layers? River-Between? What does any of this mean?
** '''The Sage:''' To give everything away at this point would be unwise, considering we are being watched even now. You should only be concerned about one thing.
** '''The Sage:''' Being entertaining.
** '''The Sage:''' That's the only way you will get out of this event alive...
** '''Player:''' Entertaining? What are you talking about? Who am I entertaining? Stop talking in riddles!
** '''The Sage:''' Ahh, [player name], please forgive me. In my attempts to explain, I appear to have confused you even further...
** '''The Sage:''' I will keep things simple for you; Participate in this event and you will continue to exist. Refusal to participate will end in your eventual destruction.
** '''The Sage:''' The choice is yours... hero.
** '''Player:''' Well, that doesn't really answer anything...
** '''The Sage:''' Worry not. I have much grander plans for you yet, but like all good stories we must wait for the right time and place...
** {{tact|initial}}
* {{topt|You mentioned other Leagues - how does this differ from those?}}
** '''Player:''' You mentioned other Leagues - how does this differ from those?
** '''The Sage:''' Like all events before it, the rules of the world have been altered to be more entertaining for those who are watching.
** '''The Sage:''' The biggest change has been to the Relics from the previous chapter.
** '''The Sage:''' These objects of power are now gone, I have broken them into Fragments and spread across this iteration of the world.
** '''The Sage:''' When multiple Fragments are in harmony, they can be used together to create powerful effects.
** '''Player:''' Yes, I remember you shattering them on the boat ride.
** '''Player:''' So I have Fragments to collect... got it. Are there any OTHER weird rules I should know about?
** '''The Sage:''' I understand that in previous Leagues, they limited you to smaller spaces of your world.
** '''The Sage:''' That restriction doesn't exist in this event.
** '''The Sage:''' You're free to roam your world, exploring the furthest reaches from Morytania to Kourend & Kebos.
** '''The Sage:''' But there's a catch.
** '''Player:''' Oh great... there's always a catch.
** '''The Sage:''' I've limited and reset some of your memories, meaning you won't be able to interact with certain elements of this world.
** '''The Sage:''' For example, you'll only have access to three skills: Defence, Fishing and Thieving, as well as the Combat Class you chose earlier.
** '''The Sage:''' In order to gain access to other skills, you need to complete Tasks for me.
** '''The Sage:''' Doing so gives you Sage's Renown. A rather fitting name, I thought.
** '''The Sage:''' With Renown you can purchase access to new skills as well as bosses and quests.
** '''Player:''' Why are you doing all of this? Surely I'd be more 'entertaining' if I could have all the power at once?
** '''The Sage:''' I can't just give you all that power. What kind of story starts the hero with all the power they want?
** '''The Sage:''' No, your story needs good rhythm. A sort of cadence that makes things interesting for your audience.
** '''The Sage:''' Start slow, work your way up. Become the hero you were always meant to be...
** '''The Sage:''' Once you have proven yourself, then and only then will you earn my renown.
** '''The Sage:''' That's how you provide good entertainment my friend...
** '''The Sage:''' That's how you make a hero.
** '''Player:''' I suppose you're right...
** '''The Sage:''' Do you desire more information?
** {{topt|Yes, please.}}
*** '''Player:''' Yes, please.
*** {{tact|(Leagues info interface opens.)}}
** {{topt|Not right now.}}
*** '''Player:''' Not right now.
*** '''The Sage:''' Go forward and continue your journey.
*** '''The Sage:''' Remember, we are always watching...
*** {{tact|initial}}
* {{topt|Any tips you can give me on being 'entertaining'?}}
** '''Player:''' Any tips you can give me on being 'entertaining'?
** '''The Sage:''' I have devised a number of tasks to help keep your story on track.
** '''The Sage:''' Each task has a level of difficulty: Beginner, Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
** '''The Sage:''' The more tasks you complete, the more activities you can unlock.
** '''The Sage:''' The more content you unlock the more interesting your story will become.
** '''The Sage:''' The more interesting the story the more entertained the ones watching will be.
** '''The Sage:''' Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.
** '''Player:''' What do I use these 'points' on?
** '''The Sage:''' Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Fragment Slot.
** '''The Sage:''' These slots allow you to equip more Fragments and become even stronger.
** '''The Sage:''' League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
** '''The Sage:''' Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
** '''The Sage:''' You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
** '''Player:''' So how many tasks are there?
** '''The Sage:''' More than you'll ever be able to complete, given our limited time here.
** '''The Sage:''' With so many to choose from, it's up to you to decide how your story plays out...
** '''Player:''' Ok... I think I understand what I should do now.
** '''The Sage:''' Very good. I knew I made the right choice bringing you to this chapter.
** {{tact|initial}}
* {{topt|What are Fragments?}}
** '''Player:''' What is a Fragment?
** '''The Sage:''' You remember the Relics from the previous event, yes? The sources of great power that let you achieve amazing feats.
** '''The Sage:''' Fragments are similar. As the Fragments were created from the Relics, much of their power remains but in a much-diminished form.
** '''The Sage:''' They bestow many different bonuses: from helping you cut wood, to making you a more formidable warrior.
** '''The Sage:''' Equipping Fragments will grant you their power.
** '''The Sage:''' You can also level up your Fragments, making them even MORE powerful.
** '''The Sage:''' Gaining experience as you normally would will level up your Fragments, making them even more useful.
** '''Player:''' How do I find these Fragments?
** '''The Sage:''' I have scattered the Fragments evenly across the world.
** '''The Sage:''' Anytime you kill a monster or gain more experience in a particular skill, you'll have a chance to receive a Fragment.
** '''The Sage:''' The harder the enemy or activity, the better chance you'll have.
** '''The Sage:''' You will only receive Fragments relevant to the activity, with a few exceptions.
** '''The Sage:''' I know your kind enjoy seeking out treasure. Fragments related to Treasure Trails can come from anywhere.
** '''Player:''' What happens if I try to put the Fragments back together?
** '''The Sage:''' As I said, the Fragments still contain some of their residual Relic energy.
** '''The Sage:''' When enough Fragments are brought back together they will emit the same energy they did when they were whole.
** '''The Sage:''' For example, if you find five Fragments imbued with Last Recall, you can complete the set and gain access to that Relic's full power.
** '''The Sage:''' A sort of 'Set Effect' if you will.
** '''The Sage:''' Is there anything else you wish to know?
** {{tact|initial}}
* {{topt|More options...}}
** {{topt|How does the content unlock system work?}}
*** '''Player:''' How does the content unlock system work?
*** '''The Sage:''' In this iteration of the event I have limited you, at first, to three skills: Thieving, Fishing and Defence.
*** '''The Sage:''' You can still do simple things like cut trees or mine ore, but doing so will be fruitless, as no experience will be gained.
*** '''The Sage:''' In order to gain experience in these skills, you'll need to unlock them by using my Renown.
*** '''The Sage:''' You gain renown by being entertaining, by completing tasks. The amount of Renown you earn depends on the difficulty of the task.
*** '''The Sage:''' When it comes to exceptionally strong creatures, you'll need to unlock the ability to fight them. You can see all locked creatures by opening the unlock interface.
*** '''The Sage:''' One final morsal of information you might be interested in. I understand that in previous Leagues you were forced to complete certain 'Quests' in their entirety.
*** '''The Sage:''' If you wish, you may spend Sage's Renown to skip through these Quests while still gaining any final rewards. However, be warned thaat{{sic}} I will not offer any gifts to you if you finish these quests by yourself.
*** '''The Sage:''' You should also know that by completing quests with Sage's Renown, you will not earn any final experience like you would if you finished the quest yourself.
*** '''The Sage:''' Is there anything else you wish to know.
*** {{tact|initial}}
** {{topt|How did I get here again?}}
*** '''Player:''' How did I get here again?
*** '''The Sage:''' I can retell the story, if you wish me to.
*** {{topt|Yes, please.}}
**** '''Player:''' Yes, please.
**** {{qact|League Intro cutscene replays.}}
*** {{topt|Not right now.}}
**** '''Player:''' Not right now.
**** '''The Sage:''' So be it.
**** {{tact|initial}}
** {{topt|Will I be rewarded for participating in this event?}}
*** '''Player:''' Will I be rewarded for participating in this event?
*** '''The Sage:''' As you progress you'll earn League Points, which will unlock new slots and allow you to equip more Fragments.
*** '''The Sage:''' However, when our time in this world is over, you can spend your League Points to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
*** '''The Sage:''' Of course, the real reward for participating will be my master and I sparing your life once the event ends...
*** '''Player:''' Are there any other rewards I can earn from this event?
*** '''The Sage:''' I see...
*** '''The Sage:''' In my time on the River of Souls I have found that when chapters are concluded their collapsing can be... incomplete.
*** '''The Sage:''' Therefore, certain items can slip through the cracks, so to say.
*** '''The Sage:''' In fact, it's through one of these cracks that I was able to save you from the previous chapter's collapse.
*** '''The Sage:''' I collect these lost items from other worlds and keep them with me, should I ever need them one day.
*** '''The Sage:''' I'm happy to offer them as an incentive for playing your part in this event.
*** '''The Sage:''' The first item is a powerful whip.
*** '''The Sage:''' It is imbued with the energy of thousands of lost souls, forever trapped in the bondage of their iron chains.
*** '''The Sage:''' Each crack releases a deafening howl from the screams of its victims trapped within...
*** '''The Sage:''' The next item is a cannon.
*** '''The Sage:''' It's poweered{{sic}} by channelled arcane energy, each explosion teleported into the barrel from a border dimension.
*** '''The Sage:''' Using a power unknwon{{sic}}, it expels shrapnel that tears through flesh and souls alike.
*** '''The Sage:''' There are others of course. You'll be free to trade these rewards to others in your world, or you can keep them. It doesn't matter to me.
*** '''Player:''' I see. That all sounds good to me.
*** {{tbox|Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.}}
*** {{tbox|You can acess your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. Using world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.}}
*** '''The Sage:''' And hero, beware - the Shattered Relic rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues, however.
*** '''The Sage:''' Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
*** '''Player:''' League Ranks? How do they work?
*** '''The Sage:''' At the end of the League, you will be judged and given a rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.
*** '''The Sage:''' Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.
*** '''The Sage:''' The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!
*** '''The Sage:''' When the League ends, you'll get a trophy based on your rank. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.
*** '''The Sage:''' You'll also get League-to-League rewards based on your League Rank.
*** '''The Sage:''' League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
*** '''The Sage:''' Finally, I plan to recognise the first heroes to complete particular activities.
*** '''The Sage:''' You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, on the board beside me.
*** '''Player:''' Thanks!
*** '''The Sage:''' Is there anything else you wish to know?
*** {{tact|initial}}
** {{topt|Let's talk about pets.}}
*** '''Player:''' Let's talk about pets.
*** '''Player:''' Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?
*** '''The Sage:''' Of course! If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
*** '''The Sage:''' This means that if you were to ever lose it, you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free!
*** '''The Sage:''' Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. It'll be waiting with me for you to reclaim it!
*** '''Player:''' Okay! Thank you.
*** '''The Sage:''' Return to me once you have some pets and you'll be able to view your collection. Is there anything else you wish to know?
*** {{tact|initial}}
** {{topt|More options...}}
*** {{topt|Do I have any League items to collect?}}
**** '''Player:''' Do I have any items to collect?

==Standard dialogue==
* '''Zuma:''' Nilsal, [player name].
* '''Player:''' Hello, Zuma. How are things?
* '''Zuma:''' A lot less stressful up here. I think I might leave the adventuring to people like you from now on.

* '''Player:''' So you still think there is a link?
* '''Zuma:''' Oh yes. It may not have been the one I originally thought, but there must be something! They're called Moons after all!
* '''Zuma:''' The all-powerful Ranul wouldn't have just let some random creatures take on a name like that!
* '''Player:''' Hmm... It's an interesting thought.
* '''Zuma:''' Indeed. And on that note, I have some research to do! Until next time.
* {{tact|end}}
